A '''battle''' took place in the [[Quellor system/Legends|Quellor system]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] in [[3962 BBY]] as part of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the invading [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] sought to dominate the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] through an offensive they called "[[Mandalorian Triumph]]." The assault was two-pronged, with one element originating in Mandalorian territory. This charge brought many [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] under Mandalorian control as they made their way Coreward. Eventually,<ref name="Atlas" /> they [[Battle of Commenor (Mandalorian Wars)|took]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]<ref name="Warfare" /> and proceeded to attack the Quellor system, conquering it as well during the ensuing battle. Afterwards, they [[Battle of the Exodeen system (Mandalorian Wars)|moved on]] to the [[Exodeen system/Legends|Exodeen system]] and staged their [[Battle of Duro (Mandalorian Wars)|successful capture]] of Duro from there.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Quellor system was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Atlas" />
